mechanism_budget.mechanism_change_policy: All three non-incumbent entries share one mechanism family and count as one substantive mechanism change.

estimands.primary: Mean latent next-position MAE normalized by line length, with lineage then episode then sensor-realization hierarchy.
estimands.baseline_competitiveness: Candidate online MAE minus 1.10 times reflected constant-motion MAE.
estimands.incumbent_comparison: Unchanged incumbent MAE minus selected-candidate MAE; only a positive adjusted lower bound above the preregistered practical margin can promote a refinement.
estimands.adaptation: First 50 post-intervention transitions, including the first surprise, online versus complete-state frozen clone.
estimands.retention: Selected-candidate online MAE minus matched selected-candidate frozen MAE in unchanged-law primary cells.
estimands.undefined_ratio_rule: A zero or missing denominator is undefined and fails the relevant claim; it is never replaced with zero.

ranking.weights: No weighted composite; all listed constraints are conjunctive.
ranking.tie_break: configuration_hash ascending after all constraints and then candidate_id ascending
ranking.multiplicity: Development ranking is descriptive and cannot consume confirmation alpha; confirmation uses one joint Holm family across A+B.
